interface.signature: def decrypt(encrypted_text: str, n: int) -> str

preconditions.expression: encrypted_text is None or encrypted_text == '' or n <= 0
preconditions.description: If the input string is null/empty or n is non-positive, return it unchanged (handled by task rules).
Input must be a string for encrypted_text and an integer for n.

postconditions.expression: decrypt(encrypted_text, n) == encrypted_text if n <= 0 else (decrypt(encrypted_text, n - 1) if n > 0 else encrypted_text)
postconditions.description: Base case: if n is 0, return the input string as-is. Otherwise, recursively apply the inverse of the encryption step (swap even and odd indices) n times.
The output string must have the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(decrypt(encrypted_text, n)[i] == encrypted_text[(i + 1) % 2 * (i // 2) + (i // 2) * (i % 2)] for i in range(len(encrypted_text))) if n % 2 == 1 else all(decrypt(encrypted_text, n)[i] == encrypted_text[i] for i in range(len(encrypted_text)))
postconditions.description: For odd n, the output is the result of swapping even and odd indices n times (equivalent to swapping once). For even n, the output is the original string (equivalent to swapping twice).
